findings.statement: Replay recomputes gates on the evaluated commit (worktreeAt) but does not say where evidence, waivers and evidence[] existence are read. Honest archive-PR: evidence-complete of MERGED in tree M^2 has no test-report (ci fetch adds it later, as in phase-4b): recorded PASS, replay FAIL, RECORD_MISMATCH. Same for APPROVED human-approval (SCN-VER-090).
findings.recommendation: Code from evaluated commit; evidence, waivers, evidence[] existence from HEAD.

findings.statement: ADR-0010 p.3: CI uses only evidence of the same run. impl kind picks the freshest admissible record among all in the working copy: a committed ci test-report with commit HEAD^2, tree of HEAD and later created_at gives PASS with failing tests.
findings.recommendation: impl kind: only records with attestation.ref of the current run.

findings.statement: .warrant/waivers/** is not own state and is a policy path: forbidden in spec-PR, no-Change PR and feature impl-PR (scope-valid). A feature Change cannot commit a waiver, yet REQ-KRN-033 and SCN-VER-047 rely on waivers.
findings.recommendation: Allow waivers of the own Change as own state.

findings.statement: archive kind has no path rule besides openspec/specs/**; feature has no scope-valid on MERGED->ARCHIVED, so code and policy paths pass.
Replay of evidence gates checks existence and admissibility only; recorded verdict vs evidence_status and waivers, missing or extra gates, effective_policy_hash are not compared.
Run ref has no attempt; Re-run (ADR-0037 p.3) reuses the URL, so attempts share attestation.ref with different trees; which attempt artifact and conclusion count is unstated.

Archive check and ci fetch accept any successful run with the artifact; workflow path and dispatch branch unchecked, while pull_request runs execute the workflow of the PR and .github/** is not a policy path.
Replay takes the MERGED commit per REQ-VER-007 (freshest Change record); in an archive-PR that is a record on the archive branch, not M^2, giving COMMIT_NOT_MERGED.
Parent of the commit introducing a transition assumes linear unrewritten history: merge commits, rebase after APPROVED (human-approval STALE), edits committed with the transition are not covered.
merged_by is not compared with --by of human-approval.
impl gate violation has no error code; SCN-VER-076 cannot assert it.
impl kind not in VERIFYING: whether checks run and artifact is emitted is unstated.
Record with both spec_tree and tree: prefilter precedence undefined.
openspec archive replay assumes the lock OpenSpec version; mismatch gives false SPECS_NOT_ARCHIVED.
SCN-VER-072 requires PASS and CONFLICT findings at once.
tasks 5.2 recomputes MERGED->ARCHIVED on HEAD, spec only in replay.
owner/repo source is only in ADR-0037 p.6, not in spec.
ci fetch does not check the PR is an impl-PR; spec-PR gets a wrong dispatch hint.
Tree check applies only to records with tree; CI records without tree bypass R-12.
